title: Prove guessing regret for played-legal finite-history OSD policies
body:
Absolute-loss guessing previously had a canonical current-loss selector and a generic OSD policy framework, but no source-specialized performance theorem for arbitrary played-legal finite-history choices. This adds four public proofs using the same shared loss, interval projection and actual policy recurrence: every actual legal support has norm at most one, the next output is the actual clamp, the same eta=1/sqrt(T) trajectory has regret at most sqrt(T) for every feasible comparator, and a separately prescribed horizon family has only eventual upper-average control.

The history-sensitive canary actually derives two trajectories from one fixed policy. At the same kink/current loss, different finite pasts select +1 and -1; played global-support legality, positive regret, nonzero retained terminal distance, a false optional off-path law, the new all-comparator terminal and the horizon-family consequence are proved. The exact numerical constant one is a D=G=1 consequence of Example2.32/eq2.1; the four declarations are two helpers and two explicit refinements of one printed example.

Stacks on OPEN unmerged #181 at exact 8ce8cc580bd7311482dd40234aaf34bd9a909a8b; base branch codex/research-online-osd-policy-migration. Existing canonical12 proofs and all previous shared producers/pins/receipts remain unchanged. Fixed exogenous deterministic finite whole-function history is formalized; no independent external parameter selection, randomized/measurable policy law, executable oracle, absolute signed-regret bound or common anytime tuning is claimed.

Validation: focused3325 jobs,51 named standard-only kernel audits (47 canary declarations plus four public proofs), four frozen statement guards and26 prespecified actual proof-value pairs; combined root9092/Tests9240 jobs (cached jobs included), full harness466 tests/7 existing skips, including the current reader rerun. Exact-base contributor, scoped preservation and task shadow gates pass. A clean local Lean-verified site at 6f3da34f91f6cae02cde1c41c227c8fc2f8960b4 preserves10817 old shared IDs/URLs and adds exactly four proof nodes in one10821-node registry. Six source cards,16 notes, four curated links and seven actual browser images were checked. Distinct required automated decoder and source CONTRACT/BODY/FINAL reviews discharge R1-R8; requested Astra/medium, no human/external or runtime attestation.

Evidence starts at runs/online-guessing-osd-policy-20261007/00_context.md, accepted-decision-v1.json, integrated-gates-overlay-v1.json and final-reader-receipt-v1.json; contract docs/contracts/online-guessing-osd-policy-v1. Every failed attempt and metadata-only packaging/reader repair is retained. CLI guards enforce particular checks; the full semantic protocol also relies on explicit contracts and reviews.

The origin/main contributor diagnostic still fails for nine OTHER Chapter1 modules and is UNWAIVED. Canonical Example2.32 current publication migration, linearization/optimal-step/unit-analysis current migration, remaining Chapter1/2 maintext and necessary appendix obligations stay required. Chapter2 total is incomplete and Chapters3-16 unenumerated; whole Goal ACTIVE. This PR is a bounded proof package, not chapter/book completion. No merge, deployment, canonical-main/live update or checkout retirement.
